name.zh: 哑铃半程土耳其起立（至高桥）

purpose.zh: 练肩部稳定，在身体变换姿势时稳住手臂
purpose.en: Build shoulder stability while your body changes position.

text.zh: 负重手臂始终垂直指天，眼睛看着哑铃
text.en: Keep the loaded arm pointing straight up and your eyes on the dumbbell

text.zh: 依次肘撑、手撑坐起，再推地抬髋到高桥
text.en: Roll to your elbow, press up to sitting, then lift your hips into a bridge.

text.zh: 每一步做稳再进入下一步，原路返回
text.en: Settle each step before the next, then reverse the same way.

commonErrors.zh: 负重臂向头后或身体前方倒
commonErrors.en: Letting the loaded arm drift behind the head or in front of the body.

cautions.zh: 从很轻的重量开始，每一步做稳再继续
cautions.en: Start with a very light weight and steady each step before moving on.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.
